name: Marian University Ancilla
academic_ranking: Two-year associate/transfer-focused campus of Marian University (now branded Marian University Plymouth). Rural campus spanning 1,400+ acres with an 11:1 student-to-faculty ratio. Offers two-year associate degrees through bachelor's degree pathways in fields including agriculture, veterinary nursing, business, education, exercise science, liberal arts, and nursing.
financial_aid: Financial aid available via FAFSA; institutional scholarships and financial aid offered. No campus-specific Ancilla/Plymouth annual tuition figure is publicly published in fetchable form; the Marian University main-campus published figure (approx. $43,400 tuition and fees for 2025-26) is not attributable to the two-year Ancilla/Plymouth campus, so tuition left null to avoid misattribution.
facilities_notes: Home athletic venues associated with the Marian University Plymouth (Ancilla) Chargers include Charger Arena at LifePlex and the Charger Athletic Complex; softball listed at 20097 9B Road, Plymouth, IN 46563.
program_reputation: NJCAA/JUCO women's softball program of the Marian University Ancilla (Marian University Plymouth) Chargers, competing in the Michigan Community College Athletic Association (MCCAA). Small two-year program serving as a transfer/development pathway. Head coach Izzy Johnson leads the staff.
notes: Sources fetched live 2026-07-30 via ancilla.prestosports.com (the ancillachargers.com public domain was serving mismatched Motlow State Athletics content at time of research, so the authoritative Presto subdomain was used). Coaches page (ancilla.prestosports.com/sports/sball/coaches/index) lists a single softball staff member: Izzy Johnson, Head Coach. Roster page (ancilla.prestosports.com/sports/sball/2025-26/roster) shows 17 players. School now branded 'Marian University Plymouth'; conference confirmed as MCCAA.
